name: com.palmware.lightguns
description:
A device-agnostic lightgun integration layer for Unity's Input System. One LightgunManager routes aim, fire/reload events and physical feedback (recoil, rumble, ammo LEDs, slide return) to per-gun modules — Blamcon (USB-HID), Retro Shooter RS3 Reaper (serial), and Sinden/mouse-emulating guns — so game code never has to know which gun is connected.

Requires: Input System, and .NET Framework API compatibility level (System.IO.Ports). The Blamcon module additionally requires the com.blamcon.lightguns package.

samples.description: The Fire/Reload/Point/Submit input action asset bound for mouse, Blamcon (<LightGun>), and RS3 (<Joystick>). Import it, then assign it to the LightgunManager.
